The [[Felucia medical station/Legends|Felucia medical station]], set up by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] for a place to send its wounded, was destroyed by an '''attack''' carried out by two [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-Class Star Frigates]] and a larger [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] over the planet Felucia. This then led to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] being sent to investigate, only to be attacked by enemy [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droids]] causing them to crash-land on the planet below, which resulted in their involvement in the [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|Skirmish on Felucia]].
